learning_objective: The learner can explain how pre-training acts as a compression framework by minimizing a model's intrinsic dimension, enabling more efficient fine-tuning with fewer parameters and less data.

common_misconceptions.description: Believing that larger models have higher intrinsic dimensions after pre-training, when they actually tend to have lower ones.
Thinking pre-training only improves general performance rather than acting as a compression mechanism for downstream fine-tuning.
Assuming fine-tuning a pre-trained model requires training all parameters, ignoring that low intrinsic dimension allows for parameter-efficient methods.
